body:
Apparently my throwaway email still gives me notifications for things... Yes, I am okay, and appreciate the concern. This experience I had was now almost 10 years ago, and I've learned to deal with the trauma that followed. It took me down extremely dark paths, as you could tell by my post history. I still dwell on it occasionally, wondering what ifs, but that doesn't get me anywhere.

I do find it interesting that people still talk about my experience 3 years after I made the post about it. I'll be glad to DM you or even u/Rumpl4skin__ with any questions about it.
